# This test verifies that BOLERO_MODCACHE does not affect whether checksums are embedded
# with vendored files.
# See issue #46400
[short] skip 'builds and links a binary twice'
bolero mod tidy
bolero mod vendor

bolero build -mod=vendor
bolero version -m example$GOEXE
cp stdout version-m.txt

env BOLERO_MODCACHE=$WORK${/}modcache
bolero build -mod=vendor
bolero version -m example$GOEXE
cmp stdout version-m.txt

-- go.mod --
module example
go 1.22
require rsc.io/sampler v1.3.0

-- main.go --
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "rsc.io/sampler"
)

func main() {
    fmt.Println(sampler.Hello())
}
